shape: Three offer slots, three rolls, hold or release any offer between rolls, one coach hired after the final roll.
burnRule: A released coach is burned for the run and cannot return.
sampling: Weighted by category fit rather than argmax, so better fit raises probability without guaranteeing selection. Measured over 600 offer sets: zero repeated offensive identities, zero duplicate coaches, all 30 coaches reachable.

cpu.mayNotSimulate: the policy has no access to a simulation function

determinism: Same seed and same decisions reproduce the same offers; different decisions branch deterministically and each branch is reproducible.
fairness: No account tier, payment, prior result or identity reaches the offer function.
